description: End-to-end lifecycle for B2B partner-managed unified communications (UC) solutions: onboarding, solution design, quoting, ordering, provisioning, monitoring, and lifecycle changes.

partner_id.description: Identifier of the channel partner or reseller

solution_id.description: Identifier of a UC solution design or template

quote_id.description: Identifier of a commercial quote for a UC solution

order_id.description: Identifier of a UC service order

subscription_id.description: Identifier of an active UC subscription for a customer

user_profile.description: Standardized user profile for UC services

username.description: Unique username or UPN within the tenant

licenses.description: List of license SKUs to be assigned to the user

phone_number.description: E.164 formatted phone number, if assigned

contact_person.description: Contact person for partner or customer

actor_context.description: Context about who is performing the action and from where.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor in the IAM system.

tenant_id.description: Tenant or organization scope, if applicable.

secret_ref.description: Optional secret reference for signed webhook delivery.

attachment_ref.description: Pointer to an uploaded attachment or document.

pagination.description: Pagination and sorting controls for list endpoints.

cursor.description: Optional opaque cursor for keyset pagination.

tag_set.description: Free-form key/value tags for categorization and search.

policy_rule.description: Generic policy rule with conditions and actions.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type depends on operator.

functions.name: register_partner_customer
functions.description: Register or link a partner-managed customer tenant for unified communications services.

domains.description: Email or SIP domains associated with the tenant

initial_sites.description: Optional initial sites to register along with the customer

functions.returns: New or linked customer_id, initial site_ids (if any), and onboarding status.

functions.name: design_uc_solution
functions.description: Create or update a unified communications solution design (sites, licenses, calling, collaboration) for a partner customer.

solution_id.description: If provided, the existing solution design to update

sites.description: Sites included in this UC solution

user_mix.description: Expected number of each user type at this site

validity.description: Validity and lifecycle configuration of the solution design

functions.returns: Created or updated solution_id, solution design summary, and validation status.

functions.name: check_uc_resource_availability
functions.description: Validate technical and capacity availability for a UC solution design before quoting or ordering.

network_capacity.description: Check WAN/Internet capacity for voice and video

number_inventory.description: Check available phone numbers for the sites

license_pool.description: Check available UC licenses in partner/customer pools

override_policies.description: Optional override flags for policy-based denials

functions.returns: Availability result per site and resource type, including blocking issues, warnings, and suggested remediations.

functions.name: generate_uc_quote
functions.description: Generate a commercial quote for a UC solution including itemized pricing, discounts, and contract terms.
functions.returns: quote_id with detailed pricing breakdown, taxes, and generated proposal document references.

functions.name: list_uc_quotes
functions.description: List and filter existing UC quotes for a partner and/or customer.
functions.returns: Paginated list of quotes with summary fields and high-level pricing.

functions.name: convert_quote_to_uc_order
functions.description: Convert an accepted UC quote into an actionable service order.

customer_po_reference.description: Customer purchase order or internal reference

accept_terms.description: Indicates that the customer has accepted the service terms

functions.returns: New order_id, initial order status, and implementation timeline summary.

functions.name: get_uc_order_status
functions.description: Retrieve detailed status and milestones for a UC order, including per-site progress.
functions.returns: Order header status, timeline, site-level provisioning state, and pending actions.

functions.name: provision_uc_subscription
functions.description: Trigger or retrigger provisioning of UC services from an order into active subscriptions, including user onboarding.

user_profiles.description: Optional explicit user profiles for onboarding; if omitted, defaults from solution design are used

dn_range_ids.description: IDs of number ranges reserved for allocation

functions.returns: Provisioning job identifier, per-site and per-user provisioning status snapshot, and resulting subscription_id(s).

functions.name: retry_uc_provisioning_step
functions.description: Retry failed or stuck UC provisioning steps at site or user level, with optional rollback on failure.

failed_step_id.description: Identifier of the failed provisioning step, if known

dry_run.description: If true, simulate the retry and return impact analysis only

functions.returns: Result of retry attempt, including updated step status, errors (if any), and recommended next actions.

functions.name: update_uc_subscription
functions.description: Modify an existing UC subscription (add/remove licenses, change features, move users between sites).

delta_quantity.description: Positive to increase, negative to decrease

user_moves.description: Move users between sites or roles

quote_preview_only.description: If true, return commercial and technical impact without applying changes

functions.returns: Change order summary including pricing impact, scheduled tasks, and updated subscription snapshot.

functions.name: get_uc_subscription_overview
functions.description: Retrieve an overview of a UC subscription including sites, users, usage, and health.
functions.returns: Subscription metadata, site list, license utilization, user counts, and key health indicators.

functions.name: monitor_uc_service_health
functions.description: Query real-time and historical health metrics for UC services by subscription and site.

thresholds.description: Optional custom thresholds to highlight breaches

functions.returns: Time-series metrics per site with threshold breach indicators and summarized health score.

functions.name: suspend_or_cancel_uc_subscription
functions.description: Suspend or cancel a UC subscription, with options for partial (site-level) suspension and rollback scheduling.

auto_rollback.description: Optional automatic rollback configuration for suspension

functions.returns: Updated subscription lifecycle state, scheduled tasks, and billing impact summary.

functions.name: uc_partner_bulk_import
functions.description: Bulk import uc partner entities from an external source (CSV, JSON, or upstream system) with validation, mapping, and partial-commit support.

external_query.description: Optional query used to pull records from upstream.

records.description: Inline records, used when source_type is 'json'.

field_mapping.description: Map of source field names to target schema fields.

functions.returns: Bulk import outcome including counts of created/updated/skipped/failed records, per-record errors, and a batch reference.

functions.name: uc_partner_bulk_update
functions.description: Apply a single update payload across many uc partner entities matching a filter or explicit id list.

selector.description: How to choose entities for the update.

update.description: Field-level updates to apply. Polymorphic - one of set/unset/append.

functions.returns: Bulk update summary including total matched, updated, skipped (e.g. due to concurrency), and failures.

functions.name: uc_partner_bulk_delete
functions.description: Soft- or hard-delete (or archive) many uc partner entities in a single operation with dependency checks.

cascade.description: Whether to cascade to related entities.

include.description: List of relationship names to cascade through.

functions.returns: Bulk delete result including counts of deleted/archived/skipped entities, dependency conflicts, and a tombstone reference.

functions.name: uc_partner_bulk_export
functions.description: Export uc partner entities (and optional related data) to a downloadable artifact, optionally redacting sensitive fields.

include_related.description: Names of related collections to include.

field_projection.description: Subset of top-level fields to include.

functions.returns: Export job descriptor including job_id, expected size, status, and delivery details.

functions.name: uc_partner_search_advanced
functions.description: Faceted, full-text and structured search across uc partner entities with relevance ranking and facet aggregations.

facets.description: Field names to compute aggregations over.

functions.returns: Search response with ranked hits, total count, facet bucket counts, and pagination cursor.

functions.name: uc_partner_subscribe_to_events
functions.description: Create a notification subscription for uc partner events using one or more channels and event-type filters.
functions.returns: Subscription descriptor including subscription_id, enabled status, and validated channel configurations.

functions.name: uc_partner_list_webhook_deliveries
functions.description: List webhook delivery attempts for uc partner notifications with filters for status, time window, and subscription.
functions.returns: Paginated list of webhook delivery records including attempt counts, response codes, and last error.

functions.name: uc_partner_get_audit_log
functions.description: Retrieve the audit trail for one or more uc partner entities with actor, change, and diff information.
functions.returns: Paginated audit events ordered by time with field-level diffs when requested.

functions.name: uc_partner_schedule_recurring_job
functions.description: Schedule a recurring job (e.g. health probe, report generation, sync) related to uc partner on a cron/interval/calendar schedule.

target.description: Target scope of the job (entity ids and/or filter).

parameters_payload.description: Job-specific parameters passed at each run.

functions.returns: Scheduled job descriptor including job_id, next_run_at, enablement status, and schedule summary.

functions.name: uc_partner_simulate_operation
functions.description: Simulate a uc partner operation (e.g. change, deploy, terminate) without committing changes, returning predicted effects and warnings.

snapshot_id.description: Optional snapshot id to simulate against a frozen state.

functions.returns: Simulation report with predicted state diff, dependency impacts, warnings, errors, and cost estimate.

functions.name: uc_partner_request_approval
functions.description: Open an approval request for a pending uc partner change, with reviewers, justification, and SLA.
functions.returns: Approval request record including approval_request_id, status, due_at, and current quorum.

functions.name: uc_partner_record_approval_decision
functions.description: Record an individual approver's decision on a pending uc partner approval request and advance the workflow.

side_effects.description: Optional side effects of this decision.

functions.returns: Updated approval request state including remaining required approvers and whether the request is now finalized.

functions.name: uc_partner_add_comment
functions.description: Attach a comment, internal note, or @-mention to a uc partner entity for collaboration.

body.description: Markdown or rich-text body of the comment.

functions.returns: Created comment record including comment_id, created_at, and notification fan-out summary.

functions.name: uc_partner_attach_evidence
functions.description: Attach one or more evidence files (logs, screenshots, contracts, diagnostics) to a uc partner entity.
functions.returns: Attachment registration result with stored attachment IDs, virus-scan status, and any redactions applied.

functions.name: uc_partner_create_snapshot
functions.description: Create a point-in-time snapshot of a uc partner entity (and optionally its dependencies) for restore or comparison.
functions.returns: Snapshot descriptor including snapshot_id, size, scope manifest, and retention date.

functions.name: uc_partner_restore_snapshot
functions.description: Restore a uc partner entity from a previously captured snapshot, with conflict-resolution and dry-run options.
functions.returns: Restore result including restored entity id, conflicts, applied paths, and the resulting state version.

functions.name: uc_partner_get_kpi_metrics
functions.description: Compute aggregated KPIs and time series for uc partner activity over a time range, grouped by chosen dimensions.
functions.returns: Aggregated KPI snapshot with per-bucket time series, totals, and optional period-over-period deltas.

functions.name: uc_partner_pin_to_dashboard
functions.description: Pin a uc partner view, metric, or saved query to an operations dashboard for at-a-glance monitoring.
functions.returns: Created dashboard tile descriptor including tile_id, dashboard_id, and effective configuration.

functions.name: uc_partner_upsert_policy
functions.description: Create or update a governance/automation policy that applies to uc partner entities with rule conditions and actions.
functions.returns: Policy descriptor including policy_id, current version, rule count, and validation warnings.

functions.name: uc_partner_evaluate_policy
functions.description: Evaluate one or more policies against a given uc partner payload or live entity and return decisions and matched rules.

target.description: Either an entity reference or an inline payload to evaluate.

functions.returns: Policy evaluation report listing decisions (allow/deny/remediate), matched rules, and explanations per rule.

functions.name: uc_partner_get_dependency_graph
functions.description: Return the dependency or association graph for a uc partner entity, including inbound and outbound links.
functions.returns: Graph response containing nodes and edges up to the requested depth with edge labels and metadata.

functions.name: uc_partner_manage_links_and_tags
functions.description: Add, remove or replace tags and cross-entity links for a uc partner entity in a single atomic operation.

links.description: Links to add, remove, or update.

functions.returns: Updated entity reference with applied tag and link changes plus any conflicts encountered.
